newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up in record turnover.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up in record turnover.

text.p: Gains by blue chip engineering, food and cement scrips helped Dhaka stocks to close 2.62 percent up on record turnover, brokers said on Tuesday.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index rose 85.75 points or 2.62 percent to 3,358.66. Turnover hit a record 786.9 million taka. Of 113 traded issues 70 rose and 43 lost.
Beximco Pharma continued to be the market leader with 599,155 scrips trading at 449.95 taka, down by 14.39. Brokers said foreign as well as local institutional investors were active in trading.
Apex Foods rose 1,000.86 taka to 21,022.28 and Bangladesh Tobacco Co gained 19.12 to 401.52.
